small_guidance: Reduce register pressure (currently 80 reg/thread limits occupancy to 50%): reduce BLOCK to 128 and lower BLOCK_IC to actual IC=16 (constexpr) so the inner loop is a single iteration and avoids redundant masking. Hoist the kd/kh/kw validity computations out and skip iterations whose stride-divisibility is statically impossible. Add @triton.autotune over BLOCK in {64,128,256} with num_warps in {2,4,8} and num_stages in {2,3}.
large_guidance: Switch from gather-based output-per-program to scatter-add via input×weight outer product: one program per (N, IC tile, input-spatial tile) computes input[n,ic,id,ih,iw] * weight[ic,oc,kd,kh,kw] and atomically (or via per-program private accumulation) scatters into output[n,oc, id*SD-PD+kd, ...]. Better: implement as an im2col-style GEMM where rows are (N*OD*OH*OW) and cols are OC, K-axis is IC*KD*KH*KW with proper stride/pad index math, using BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=32, BLOCK_K=16 fp32 tiles to fit SMEM. Use channels_last3d layout so IC is contiguous along the GEMM-K dimension, and fuse the BN scale/shift + spatial-mean subtract epilogue by computing per-(n,oc) spatial sum in a second small kernel.
